blocks.zh: III.F.1. Liquid-Based Oral Drug Products 液體口服劑型
blocks.en: III.F.1. Liquid-Based Oral Drug Products

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Acute vs. Chronic Dosing 的安全性評估差異：
blocks.en: Differences in safety assessment for acute vs. chronic dosing:

blocks.zh: Acute (短期)： 引用 indirect food additive regulations (21 CFR 174-186) 通常即足夠——假設藥品包裝的暴露量與食品包裝相當。
blocks.en: Acute (short-term): Citing the indirect food additive regulations (21 CFR 174-186) is usually sufficient, on the assumption that exposure from drug packaging is comparable to that from food packaging.

blocks.zh: Chronic (長期, 數月至數年)： 僅引用 food additive 法規只有在以下條件下才足夠：(1) 病人對 extractables 的暴露量不超過食品暴露量；或 (2) 暴露時長有毒理學數據支持。含共溶劑的配方需要額外的 extractable 資訊。
blocks.en: Chronic (months to years): Citing only the food additive regulations is sufficient only if: (1) patient exposure to extractables does not exceed exposure from food; or (2) toxicological data support the duration of exposure. Formulations containing cosolvents need additional extractables information.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: Acute vs. chronic 的差異就像「偶爾外食」vs.「天天吃便當」——如果便當盒的塑膠偶爾溶出微量物質，偶爾一次影響不大（acute）；但如果天天用同一個便當盒加熱再吃，累積暴露量就值得關注了（chronic）。FDA 的邏輯是：食品包裝法規假設的是一般飲食模式，但長期服藥的暴露模式可能超出這個假設。
blocks.en: The acute vs. chronic distinction is like eating out occasionally vs. eating a packed lunch every day. If the plastic lunch box leaches a trace of material now and then, one occasional meal makes little difference (acute). But if you reheat and eat from the same lunch box every day, the accumulated exposure deserves attention (chronic). FDA's logic is that the food packaging regulations assume a general dietary pattern, while the exposure pattern of long-term medication may exceed that assumption.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 共溶劑的「放大鏡效應」：含有 alcohol、glycol、polysorbate 等共溶劑的配方，會從塑膠包裝中萃取出比純水更多的物質。FDA 明確表示，這種情況下「additional extractable information may be needed」——即使是口服產品。
blocks.en: The "magnifying glass effect" of cosolvents: Formulations containing cosolvents such as alcohol, glycol or polysorbate extract more from plastic packaging than plain water does. FDA states explicitly that in this case "additional extractable information may be needed", even for an oral product.

blocks.zh: USP 對 PE/PP/Laminate 安全性的空白：USP General Chapters 沒有專門針對 HDPE、LDPE、PP 或 laminate 材料的安全性測試。這個空白由 indirect food additive regulations 填補——但有上述的使用限制。
blocks.en: The gap in USP for PE/PP/laminate safety: The USP General Chapters have no safety tests specifically for HDPE, LDPE, PP or laminate materials. This gap is filled by the indirect food additive regulations, subject to the usage limitations described above.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 雖然無菌 CDMO 不常處理非無菌口服液體，但理解此分級邏輯有助於整體 CCS 知識體系。當 CDMO 處理 oral solution for injection reconstitution 的配套稀釋液時，稀釋液的包裝安全性評估需考慮：(1) 是否含共溶劑；(2) 是否為長期使用；(3) 是否可僅引用 food additive 法規。
blocks.en: Sterile CDMOs seldom handle non-sterile oral liquids, but understanding this tiering logic helps build overall CCS knowledge. When a CDMO handles the accompanying diluent for an oral solution for injection reconstitution, the packaging safety assessment for the diluent should consider: (1) whether it contains cosolvents; (2) whether it is for long-term use; (3) whether citing only the food additive regulations is acceptable.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個含 15% ethanol 的口服溶液，長期服用 (chronic)，使用 HDPE 瓶包裝。僅引用 21 CFR 177.1520 (Olefin polymers) 是否足以證明安全性？為什麼？
blocks.en: An oral solution containing 15% ethanol is taken chronically and packaged in an HDPE bottle. Is citing only 21 CFR 177.1520 (Olefin polymers) sufficient to demonstrate safety? Why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 認為口服製劑的 performance 通常不是考量因素？有沒有例外？
blocks.en: Why does FDA consider performance usually not a concern for oral dosage forms? Are there exceptions?

blocks.zh: III.F.2. Topical Drug Products 外用製劑
blocks.en: III.F.2. Topical Drug Products

blocks.zh: Tube 包裝的技術細節：
blocks.en: Technical details of tube packaging:

blocks.zh: 1. Blind-end vs. Open-end: Blind-end tube 儲存時產品不接觸瓶蓋；Open-end 則需折疊/壓邊密封
blocks.en: 1. Blind-end vs. open-end: With a blind-end tube, the product does not contact the cap during storage; an open-end tube needs to be folded/crimped to seal.

blocks.zh: 2. Tube liner: 通常為 lacquer 或 shellac，防止金屬管與產品直接接觸。鋁管通常有 liner。
blocks.en: 2. Tube liner: Usually a lacquer or shellac, which prevents direct contact between the metal tube and the product. Aluminum tubes usually have a liner.

blocks.zh: 3. Closure method: Roll fold 或 saddle fold，以及密封劑的類型和組成
blocks.en: 3. Closure method: Roll fold or saddle fold, and the type and composition of the sealant.

blocks.zh: Collapsible tube 就像牙膏管——看似簡單，但內部結構（管壁材質、內襯、密封方式、填充量控制）都有學問。鋁管需要內襯防止金屬與軟膏反應，就像炒菜鍋需要不沾塗層防止食物黏鍋。Blind-end tube 的設計讓儲存時藥膏只接觸管壁和內襯，不碰蓋子——減少了一個接觸面的相容性風險。
blocks.en: A collapsible tube is like a toothpaste tube: it looks simple, but there is a lot of science in the internal structure (tube wall material, liner, sealing method, fill-volume control). An aluminum tube needs a liner to keep the metal from reacting with the ointment, much as a frying pan needs a non-stick coating to keep food from sticking. The blind-end design means the ointment touches only the tube wall and liner during storage, not the cap, which removes one contact surface and its compatibility risk.

blocks.zh: 外用製劑的安全性考量提升：雖然是外用，但 FDA 特別指出這些產品可能接觸「mucosal membranes or skin that has been broken or otherwise compromised」——破損皮膚的滲透性接近靜脈注射。因此外用製劑的材料安全性不能完全等同於固體口服劑型。
blocks.en: Higher safety considerations for topical products: Although applied externally, FDA specifically notes that these products may contact "mucosal membranes or skin that has been broken or otherwise compromised", and the permeability of broken skin approaches that of intravenous administration. The material safety of topical products therefore cannot be treated as entirely equivalent to that of solid oral dosage forms.

blocks.zh: Sterile topical products：某些外用產品需要無菌或符合微生物限度——如 sterile dressings、眼用製劑。這些需要額外的包裝評估。
blocks.en: Sterile topical products: Some topical products must be sterile or meet microbial limits, such as sterile dressings and ophthalmic products. These need additional packaging evaluation.

blocks.zh: 如果一個外用軟膏的鋁管 liner 出現裂紋，可能造成什麼問題？如何在 QC 中監控 liner integrity？
blocks.en: If the liner of an aluminum tube for a topical ointment cracks, what problems could result? How can liner integrity be monitored in QC?

blocks.zh: Blind-end tube 和 open-end tube 的相容性測試範圍有何不同？
blocks.en: How does the scope of compatibility testing differ between blind-end tubes and open-end tubes?

blocks.zh: III.F.3. Topical Delivery Systems 經皮/外用藥物遞送系統
blocks.en: III.F.3. Topical Delivery Systems

blocks.zh: Topical Delivery Systems 三類型：
blocks.en: Three types of topical delivery systems:

blocks.zh: 1. Transdermal (經皮): 黏貼在皮膚上，可能放置數天
blocks.en: 1. Transdermal: Adhered to the skin, possibly for several days.

blocks.zh: 2. Ocular (眼用): 插入下眼瞼，通常 7 天
blocks.en: 2. Ocular: Inserted under the lower eyelid, usually for 7 days.

blocks.zh: 3. Intrauterine (子宮內): 可放置長達一年
blocks.en: 3. Intrauterine: May remain in place for up to one year.

blocks.zh: Rate-controlling membrane (速率控制膜): 控制藥物釋放速率的關鍵組件——其 performance 和 QC 是送審的重點。
blocks.en: Rate-controlling membrane: The key component that controls the rate of drug release; its performance and QC are a focus of the submission.

blocks.zh: Rate-controlling membrane 就像水龍頭的流量控制器——決定藥物以多快的速度釋放到皮膚/眼睛/子宮。如果膜的品質不一致（批次間厚度差異），就像每個水龍頭出水量不同——有的病人得到太多藥物，有的太少。這就是為什麼 performance QC 對 delivery systems 至關重要。
blocks.en: A rate-controlling membrane is like the flow regulator on a faucet: it determines how fast the drug is released onto the skin, into the eye or into the uterus. If membrane quality is inconsistent (thickness varying between batches), it is like every faucet delivering a different flow, so some patients get too much drug and others too little. This is why performance QC is critical for delivery systems.

blocks.zh: Transdermal patch 的 CCS 非常特殊——patch 本身既是 drug product 也是 delivery device，而包裝它的 blister pack 才是傳統意義的 CCS。FDA 對 patch 的材料安全性要求等同 topical products，但 performance (drug delivery rate) 的要求則更接近 MDI/DPI 這類精確劑量遞送裝置。
blocks.en: The CCS of a transdermal patch is very special: the patch itself is both the drug product and the delivery device, while the blister pack that holds it is the CCS in the traditional sense. FDA's material safety requirements for a patch are the same as for topical products, but its performance (drug delivery rate) requirements are closer to those for precise dose-delivery devices such as MDIs and DPIs.

blocks.zh: Intrauterine system 可能在體內放置長達一年——這對材料的長期相容性和安全性提出了極高要求。
blocks.en: An intrauterine system may remain in the body for up to one year, which places very high demands on long-term material compatibility and safety.

blocks.zh: Transdermal patch 的 rate-controlling membrane 的 QC 測試應包括哪些項目？批次間變異對藥物遞送速率有何影響？
blocks.en: What items should QC testing of the rate-controlling membrane of a transdermal patch include? How does batch-to-batch variability affect the drug delivery rate?

blocks.zh: Intrauterine system 放置長達一年——材料的 biocompatibility testing 應參考哪些標準（提示：ISO 10993）？
blocks.en: An intrauterine system stays in place for up to one year. Which standards should the biocompatibility testing of its materials refer to (hint: ISO 10993)?

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Table Analysis
blocks.en: Table Analysis

blocks.zh: Table 6 vs Table 4 的關鍵差異：
blocks.en: Key differences between Table 6 and Table 4:

blocks.zh: Safety 簡化：不要求 USP <381> 或 <87>/<88>——引用 food additive regulations 通常足夠
blocks.en: Simplified safety: USP <381> or <87>/<88> are not required; citing the food additive regulations is usually sufficient.

blocks.zh: Chronic dosing 的額外要求：含酒精/共溶劑的長期口服產品須證明 extractables 暴露量不超過食品暴露量
blocks.en: Additional requirements for chronic dosing: Long-term oral products containing alcohol/cosolvents must demonstrate that extractables exposure does not exceed exposure from food.

blocks.zh: Tube-specific：coating integrity testing（金屬管的內襯完整性）
blocks.en: Tube-specific: Coating integrity testing (liner integrity of metal tubes).

blocks.zh: Protection 差異：新增 seal integrity/leak testing for tubes 和 unit-dose containers
blocks.en: Protection differences: Adds seal integrity/leak testing for tubes and unit-dose containers.

blocks.zh: 腳註 <sup>b</sup> 的食品分類法：aqueous（水性）、acidic（酸性）、alcoholic（含醇）、fatty（油脂性）——這對應 FDA 食品接觸材料的萃取模擬條件
blocks.en: The food classification in footnote <sup>b</sup>: aqueous, acidic, alcoholic and fatty, which corresponds to the extraction simulation conditions for FDA food contact materials.

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 協助客戶評估口服液體或外用製劑的包裝安全性時，關鍵決策樹：(1) 先判斷 acute vs. chronic dosing → (2) 再判斷配方是否含共溶劑 → (3) 若為 chronic + 含共溶劑 → 需要 extractables 比較數據或 toxicological 支持，不能僅引用 food additive 法規。
blocks.en: When a CDMO helps a client assess the packaging safety of an oral liquid or topical product, the key decision tree is: (1) first determine acute vs. chronic dosing; (2) then determine whether the formulation contains cosolvents; (3) if chronic and cosolvent-containing, extractables comparison data or toxicological support are needed, and the food additive regulations cannot simply be cited alone.

blocks.zh: 比較 Table 4 (Injectable) 和 Table 6 (Oral/Topical) 的 Safety 要求——具體列出三個主要差異及其原因。
blocks.en: Compare the Safety requirements of Table 4 (Injectable) and Table 6 (Oral/Topical), and list the three main differences and the reasons for them.

blocks.zh: III.G. Solid Oral Dosage Forms and Powders for Reconstitution III.G. 固體口服劑型與重配製粉末
blocks.en: III.G. Solid Oral Dosage Forms and Powders for Reconstitution

blocks.zh: WVPR (水蒸氣透過率) 三大 USP 測試：
blocks.en: The three main USP water vapor permeation tests:

blocks.zh: 1. USP <661> (PE Containers): 僅測容器本身（用 foil 密封）
blocks.en: 1. USP <661> (PE Containers): Tests only the container itself (sealed with foil).

blocks.zh: 2. USP <671> Single-Unit: 測整個 CCS，分 5 級 (Class A–E)
blocks.en: 2. USP <671> Single-Unit: Tests the whole CCS, with 5 classes (Class A-E).

blocks.zh: 3. USP <671> Multiple-Unit: 測去除 inner seal 後的 CCS，分 2 級 (tight/well-closed)
blocks.en: 3. USP <671> Multiple-Unit: Tests the CCS after the inner seal is removed, with 2 classes (tight/well-closed).

blocks.zh: Blister Package 結構：Lidding material (通常含 aluminum foil barrier layer + print primer + heat-sealing lacquer) + Forming film (single film, coated, or laminate)。Sealing agent 接觸劑型和 forming film。
blocks.en: Blister package structure: Lidding material (usually an aluminum foil barrier layer + print primer + heat-sealing lacquer) + forming film (single film, coated, or laminate). The sealing agent contacts the dosage form and the forming film.

blocks.zh: WVPR 測試就像房屋的「防潮測試」——USP <661> 只測牆壁本身的防潮能力（用完美的門窗密封）；USP <671> multiple-unit 測試則在打開門窗的情況下測整棟房子——包括牆壁和門窗接縫處的漏水。去除 inner seal 後測試反映了病人開封後的實際使用條件。
blocks.en: Water vapor permeation testing is like a "moisture-proofing test" for a house. USP <661> tests only the moisture resistance of the walls themselves (with perfectly sealed doors and windows); the USP <671> multiple-unit test tests the whole house with the doors and windows open, including leakage at the wall and window/door joints. Testing after removal of the inner seal reflects the actual conditions of use once the patient has opened the pack.

blocks.zh: Blister package 就像雞蛋盒——forming film 做出凹槽放雞蛋（藥錠），lidding foil 蓋上密封。鋁箔層是防潮的關鍵屏障。
blocks.en: A blister package is like an egg carton: the forming film makes the cavities that hold the eggs (tablets), and the lidding foil covers and seals them. The aluminum foil layer is the key moisture barrier.

blocks.zh: Powder for Reconstitution 的安全性要求提升：FDA 明確表示，對復溶用粉末「reference only to the indirect food additive regulations is not recommended」——因為復溶後液體會與包裝接觸，安全性要求應高於固體。
blocks.en: Higher safety requirements for powder for reconstitution: FDA states explicitly that for powders for reconstitution, "reference only to the indirect food additive regulations is not recommended", because the reconstituted liquid contacts the packaging and the safety requirements should therefore be higher than for solids.

blocks.zh: Rayon filler 的溶出問題：Rayon 已被發現可能導致 gelatin capsules 和 gelatin-coated tablets 的溶出問題——選擇 filler 時必須考慮此因素。
blocks.en: Dissolution problems with rayon filler: Rayon has been found to cause dissolution problems with gelatin capsules and gelatin-coated tablets, so this must be considered when selecting a filler.

blocks.zh: Desiccant 的物理區分：Desiccant 的形狀和大小應與藥錠/膠囊不同，防止病人誤食。這是一個簡單但重要的安全設計原則。
blocks.en: Physical distinction of desiccants: The shape and size of a desiccant should differ from the tablets/capsules to prevent patients from swallowing it by mistake. This is a simple but important safety design principle.

blocks.zh: 雖然固體口服劑型不是無菌 CDMO 的核心業務，但 powders for injection（復溶用凍乾粉末）在無菌 CDMO 中極為常見。此類產品的 CCS 考量：(1) 凍乾粉末的水蒸氣保護至關重要——stopper 的 MVTR (moisture vapor transmission rate) 是關鍵參數；(2) 復溶後的液體與容器接觸，安全性要求介於固體口服和注射劑之間；(3) 應按 Table 2 的 Case 2c (compatibility) 和 Case 2s (safety) 進行評估。
blocks.en: Solid oral dosage forms are not core business for a sterile CDMO, but powders for injection (lyophilized powders for reconstitution) are extremely common in sterile CDMOs. CCS considerations for such products: (1) water vapor protection of the lyophilized powder is critical, and the stopper's MVTR (moisture vapor transmission rate) is a key parameter; (2) the reconstituted liquid contacts the container, so the safety requirements fall between those for solid oral products and injectables; (3) evaluation should follow Case 2c (compatibility) and Case 2s (safety) in Table 2.

blocks.zh: 對一個凍乾注射劑（powder for injection），stopper 的 MVTR 為什麼比 liquid injection 更重要？如何測試和設定接受標準？
blocks.en: For a lyophilized injectable (powder for injection), why is the stopper MVTR more important than for a liquid injection? How should it be tested and the acceptance criterion set?

blocks.zh: USP <671> 的 Class A–E 分級如何影響藥品標籤上的儲存條件描述？
blocks.en: How do the USP <671> Class A-E classifications affect the storage condition statements on the drug label?

blocks.zh: Table 7 是所有 Table 中要求最簡化的：
blocks.en: Table 7 has the most simplified requirements of all the Tables:

blocks.zh: Protection: 聚焦在 light 和 moisture permeation（無 sterility、gas、solvent loss 要求）
blocks.en: Protection: Focused on light and moisture permeation (no sterility, gas or solvent loss requirements).

blocks.zh: Safety: 引用 indirect food additive regulations 通常即可（但 powders for reconstitution 除外）
blocks.en: Safety: Citing the indirect food additive regulations is usually sufficient (except for powders for reconstitution).

blocks.zh: 特有項目: Fillers (cotton/rayon) 和 desiccants 的規定——這些在注射劑 Table 4 中未出現
blocks.en: Unique items: Provisions for fillers (cotton/rayon) and desiccants, which do not appear in Table 4 for injectables.

blocks.zh: 無 sterility/depyrogenation 要求——反映了非無菌產品的本質
blocks.en: No sterility/depyrogenation requirements, reflecting the nature of non-sterile products.

blocks.zh: 與 Table 4 (Injectable) 相比，Table 7 省略了：USP <381>、USP Biological Reactivity Tests、121°C extraction、swelling evaluation、sterilization validation 等——這些都是無菌高風險產品特有的要求。
blocks.en: Compared with Table 4 (Injectable), Table 7 omits USP <381>, USP Biological Reactivity Tests, 121°C extraction, swelling evaluation, sterilization validation and so on; these are all requirements specific to high-risk sterile products.

blocks.zh: 比較 Tables 3, 4, 6, 7 可以建立一個「CCS 送審要求的風險梯度」——從 Table 4 (Injectable, 最嚴格) → Table 6 (Oral liquid/Topical, 中等) → Table 7 (Solid oral, 最簡化)。CDMO 在為不同劑型的客戶準備 CCS documentation 時，應依據此梯度調整工作範圍和資源配置。
blocks.en: Comparing Tables 3, 4, 6 and 7 gives a "risk gradient of CCS submission requirements": from Table 4 (Injectable, most stringent) to Table 6 (Oral liquid/Topical, intermediate) to Table 7 (Solid oral, most simplified). When preparing CCS documentation for clients with different dosage forms, a CDMO should adjust the scope of work and resource allocation according to this gradient.

blocks.zh: 請列出 Table 4 (Injectable) 有但 Table 7 (Solid oral) 沒有的所有 Safety 測試要求。這些差異的科學依據是什麼？
blocks.en: List all the Safety test requirements that Table 4 (Injectable) has but Table 7 (Solid oral) does not. What is the scientific basis for these differences?

blocks.zh: 對於一個既有 powder for injection 也有 oral tablet 的產品線，CDMO 如何規劃 CCS qualification 的資源分配？
blocks.en: For a product line that includes both a powder for injection and an oral tablet, how should a CDMO plan the allocation of resources for CCS qualification?

blocks.zh: III.H. Other Dosage Forms 其他劑型
blocks.en: III.H. Other Dosage Forms

blocks.zh: 「其他劑型」的 first principles 方法：對未被前述章節涵蓋的劑型，FDA 提供了三個基本考量原則：
blocks.en: A first-principles approach to "other dosage forms": For dosage forms not covered by the preceding sections, FDA provides three basic considerations:

blocks.zh: 1. 給藥途徑和劑型性質決定的相容性/安全性 concern
blocks.en: 1. The compatibility/safety concerns determined by the route of administration and the nature of the dosage form.

blocks.zh: 2. CCS 應提供的保護類型
blocks.en: 2. The type of protection the CCS should provide.

blocks.zh: 3. 該藥品特有的處理或操作對包裝的影響
blocks.en: 3. The impact on the packaging of any handling or operations specific to the drug product.

blocks.zh: FDA 對「其他劑型」的指引就像一本食譜書最後的「即興創作指南」——沒有具體食譜，但給你三個基本原則（風味平衡、火候控制、食材搭配）讓你能處理任何新菜色。同理，對任何新劑型，回歸 safety、protection、unique handling 三個 first principles 即可建構 CCS 策略。
blocks.en: FDA's guidance on "other dosage forms" is like the "improvisation guide" at the end of a cookbook: there is no specific recipe, but it gives you three basic principles (balancing flavors, controlling heat, pairing ingredients) so you can handle any new dish. Likewise, for any new dosage form, you can build a CCS strategy by going back to the three first principles of safety, protection and unique handling.

blocks.zh: 隨著 combination products 和新型 drug delivery systems 的發展（如植入物、微針貼片、3D 列印藥物等），本節的 first principles 方法變得越來越重要。FDA 不可能預見所有未來劑型，但這三個原則提供了通用的思考框架。
blocks.en: With the development of combination products and new drug delivery systems (such as implants, microneedle patches and 3D-printed drugs), the first-principles approach in this section is becoming increasingly important. FDA cannot anticipate every future dosage form, but these three principles provide a universal framework for thinking.

blocks.zh: 對於一種新型的長效緩釋植入物 (drug-eluting implant)，您會如何應用 Section III.H 的三個 first principles 來設計 CCS qualification 策略？
blocks.en: For a new long-acting drug-eluting implant, how would you apply the three first principles of Section III.H to design a CCS qualification strategy?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 液體口服劑型：Safety 分級取決於 acute vs. chronic dosing 和配方是否含共溶劑。Chronic + cosolvent 需要超出 food additive reference 的額外 extractable 數據
blocks.en: Oral liquids: The safety tier depends on acute vs. chronic dosing and on whether the formulation contains cosolvents. Chronic dosing with cosolvents requires additional extractables data beyond the food additive reference.

blocks.zh: 外用製劑：Tube 包裝有特殊的結構考量（liner、fold type、sealant）；接觸破損皮膚/黏膜的產品安全性要求高於一般外用
blocks.en: Topical products: Tube packaging has special structural considerations (liner, fold type, sealant); products contacting broken skin or mucosa have higher safety requirements than general topical products.

blocks.zh: Topical delivery systems：Rate-controlling membrane 的 performance QC 是關鍵；intrauterine system 的長期生物相容性要求最高
blocks.en: Topical delivery systems: Performance QC of the rate-controlling membrane is key; intrauterine systems have the highest long-term biocompatibility requirements.

blocks.zh: 固體口服劑型：水蒸氣保護是核心考量——三大 USP 測試 (USP <661>, <671> single-unit, <671> multiple-unit)
blocks.en: Solid oral dosage forms: Water vapor protection is the core consideration, with three main USP tests (USP <661>, <671> single-unit, <671> multiple-unit).

blocks.zh: Blister packages：Lidding (foil barrier) + Forming film 結構；leak testing 是 IPC 關鍵項目
blocks.en: Blister packages: Lidding (foil barrier) + forming film structure; leak testing is a key IPC item.

blocks.zh: Fillers (cotton/rayon) 和 desiccants 是 primary packaging components——需要適當的 suitability 數據
blocks.en: Fillers (cotton/rayon) and desiccants are primary packaging components and need appropriate suitability data.

blocks.zh: Table 6 和 Table 7 相對 Table 4 簡化，反映了口服/外用 vs. 注射劑的風險差異
blocks.en: Tables 6 and 7 are simplified relative to Table 4, reflecting the difference in risk between oral/topical products and injectables.

blocks.zh: 未涵蓋的劑型：回歸 safety/compatibility + protection + unique handling 三個 first principles
blocks.en: Dosage forms not covered: Return to the three first principles of safety/compatibility + protection + unique handling.
